outbox.body:
Harbor State exposure: $95.5mm across FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP ($42.0mm), FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING ($18.0mm), and FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC ($35.5mm).

This month’s new release shows 8 cited signals across your held BDCs.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP
- Two new markdowns. Cedar Ridge Dental Partners LLC moved to 91.5 from 98.0, a 6.5-point decline (accession 0009000011-26-000111, row 102; prior row 502).
- Granite Peak Manufacturing LLC moved to 92.0 from 98.5, a 6.5-point decline (accession 0009000011-26-000111, row 106; prior row 506).

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING
- Pinecrest Learning Group Inc. maturity was extended to 2031-09-30 from 2029-09-30 (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 105; prior row 505).
- Brightwater Fitness Holdings LLC moved to 93.5 from 99.0, a 5.5-point decline (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 101; prior row 501).
- Oakmont Home Services LLC PIK increased to 3.0 from 1.0 (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 104; prior row 504).

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC
- Dunmore Insurance Brokers LLC maturity was extended to 2030-03-15 from 2028-03-15 (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 104; prior row 504).
- Crestline Roofing Holdings LLC moved to 90.0 from 97.5, a 7.5-point decline (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 103; prior row 503).
- Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc. PIK increased to 2.5 from 0.0 (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 106; prior row 506).

Takeaway
- The release adds fresh stress signals in all three held BDCs.
- Hotel stands out because the same schedule shows a maturity extension, a 5.5-point markdown, and a PIK increase.
- Golf adds two separate 6.5-point markdowns.
- Juliett adds one 7.5-point markdown, one maturity extension, and one new PIK balance.

Prepared for Priya approval before any send to the mock outbox.
